note: Windows 11 24H2 bugchecked when a pool of four disks (a one-column and a four-column simple space, a one- and a two-column two-way mirror and a parity space with its cache) arrived with one disk absent: first with the pool created on Linux (tools/health-states.sh, state no0: base disk 0 absent), then with the same layout created by Windows itself (scenario c11ctl, disk3.vhdx absent, the disk holding the one-column simple space). The same pool with every disk attached was healthy. Faulting address and stack read from the triage minidumps (module list and the crashing thread's stack).
